name: Comparative Literature
notes: Ten courses (40 credits) across one of three tracks: Comparative Literature and Cultural Studies; Comparative Literature and Critical Theory; and a third track relating a non-English literature to other media.
ALL tracks require the student to demonstrate advanced proficiency in at least one non-English language - not modeled as coursework.

NEEDS VERIFICATION: the eight non-core courses differ per track (track 1 = eight courses across at least two national literatures; track 2 = three-to-five in national literatures plus three-to-five in critical theory). They are modeled as eight CLTR/MLC-language courses. Track-specific splits and the 'at least one 200-level course in each language area chosen' rule are not auto-enforced.
